# clavis schema pull

<p class="cli-lead">Download the schema as code</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis schema pull [flags]
```

</div>

Download the schema as YAML for code review. Writes `clavis.schema.yaml` by default; `-o -` prints it.

## Examples

```sh
clavis schema pull
clavis schema pull -o config/clavis.schema.yaml
```

</dl>
